ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle AOB$ is a right angle, $OP$ bisects $\angle AOB$, $OQ$ bisects $\angle AOC$, $\angle POQ=70^\circ$, find the degree of $\angle AOC$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}\\
Since $\angle AOB=90^\circ$ and OP bisects $\angle AOB$,\\
it follows that $\angle POA=45^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle POQ=70^\circ$,\\
it results in $\angle AOQ=\angle POQ-\angle POA=25^\circ$,\\
Since OQ bisects $\angle AOC$,\\
it concludes that $\angle AOC=2\angle AOQ=\boxed{50^\circ}$.
